interface.title: dms-view
interface.field: Virology / protein biochemistry: deep mutational scanning (DMS) of influenza hemagglutinin
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and interpreting results after DMS analysis, and making figures for papers
interface.what_it_is_for: Linked views of a deep mutational scanning dataset: a per-site metric along the sequence, a logo plot of per-mutation effects at chosen sites, and those sites shown on a 3D protein structure, with condition and metric switching and figure export.

data.note: The example from the README, served by the local server: data/IAV/flu_dms-view.csv (H3 HA serum-escape differential selection; conditions 2009-age-53, 2009-age-64, 2009-age-65 and 2010-age-21; 5 site metrics and 4 mutation metrics), data/IAV/4O5N_trimer.pdb and data/IAV/lee2019mapping.md (Lee et al. 2019 eLife). /data/ holds only this one dataset. The page has no file-upload input, so the test files were never uploaded. Data were loaded through the query string and also by typing the same paths into the Data, PDB and markdown URL fields on a blank page.

tree.general: Find which positions in a protein matter under different conditions, see which substitutions at those positions drive the effect and where they sit in 3D, and make figures
tree.specific: Find HA sites where human sera select escape mutations, read the amino-acid logo at each site, find the sites on the 4O5N trimer, and compare serum samples

features.name: Brushable site scatter with selection mode and focus+context zoom
features.general: A sequence-position scatter plot. Click points or drag a box to add positions to a selection, flip a select/deselect switch so the box removes them, and drag across a small overview strip to zoom the main plot into one region. The selection is also shown as an editable comma-separated list.
features.specific: The dms-view site plot (line plot): circles for each HA site's site metric, a tooltip with site, value and wildtype, a 2D brush and clicks to select, a select/deselect radio, a zoom bar to zoom, and a 'Selected sites' text box plus 'clear selections'. A brush only works when the drag starts on empty plot space.
steps: hover a point to read site, value and wildtype
click a point or drag a box (from empty space) to add sites to the selection
switch the radio to deselect and drag a box (or click a selected point) to remove sites
drag across the top of the zoom bar to zoom into one region
type a site list into the Selected sites box, or press clear selections
serves_tasks: Zoom into one region of the sequence
Read the value at one position

features.name: Logo plot of per-substitution values for the selected positions
features.general: For the positions picked elsewhere, draw a stacked-letter logo with each letter's height set to its per-substitution value. Values can be positive or negative. A dropdown switches the metric, and hovering a letter gives its value.
features.specific: The dms-view logo plot: one stack per selected site, letters scaled by mut_ metric (Positive Differential Selection, Differential Selection with letters above and below zero, DMS prefs, Natural Frequencies), a hover tooltip 'Site: 144 / E: 3.16', and Download SVG.
steps: select sites in the line plot (the logo redraws one stack per site)
choose a mutation metric from the dropdown
hover a letter to read its value
press Download SVG
serves_tasks: Read per-substitution effects at the chosen positions
Export each panel as a figure

features.name: Selection-linked 3D structure highlighter
features.general: A 3D molecule viewer that shows the currently selected sequence positions as colored spheres, colored by the same score as the plot. The model can be drawn in different styles, the selected and other chains can be recolored, and the model can be rotated, zoomed, hovered for residue labels and saved as a PNG.
features.specific: The structure view on 4O5N_trimer.pdb: selected sites appear as spacefill colored like their line-plot points. Options include a cartoon/spacefill/sticks/surface dropdown, 'colors' with 'data chains color' and 'other chains color' fields, drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, a hover atom label like '[PHE]193.A.CB', and Download PNG. Clicking a residue does not select it.
steps: select sites in the line plot (residues light up on the structure)
choose a representation (cartoon, spacefill, sticks, surface)
press colors and type colors for the data chains and the other chains
drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, hover a residue to read its label
press Download PNG
serves_tasks: Find the chosen positions on the 3D structure
Change how the 3D model is drawn
Export each panel as a figure

features.name: Condition and metric switching with the site selection held fixed
features.general: Dropdowns switch which experimental condition and which summary metric drive every linked view, while the selected positions stay selected, so the same positions can be compared across samples and scores.
features.specific: The condition dropdown (2009-age-53, 2009-age-64, 2009-age-65, 2010-age-21) and the site_ metric dropdown redraw the line plot, logo plot and structure colors and keep the selected sites.
steps: select the sites of interest
choose another condition from the condition dropdown
choose another site metric
compare how the selected sites' points, logos and structure colors changed
serves_tasks: Compare the same positions across samples
Switch which per-position score is plotted

features.name: Sources and view state held in URL parameters
features.general: Text fields set the addresses of the data table, structure and description, and every choice (sources, condition, metrics, selected positions, colors) is written into the page URL. Copying the URL saves the view, and opening it restores most of it. Opening the page without a data address shows an error banner.
features.specific: The Data URL, PDB URL and markdown URL fields load files, and the query string tracks data-url, pdb-url, markdown-url, condition, site_metric, mutation_metric, selected_sites, protein-data-color and protein-other-color. Opening the URL brings back the selection and dropdowns but not the chain colors. Opening the page with no usable data-url shows 'Error reading the data URL!'; typing a blank Data URL in the replay showed no banner. A bad PDB path clears the structure without any message.
steps: type a CSV path into Data URL and press Enter
type PDB and markdown paths into their fields
work in the views (the URL updates as you go)
copy the URL and open it later to restore the view
serves_tasks: Load data files by typing their addresses
Open a saved view from a link
Save or share the current view
